name: Fuyuiro no Muffler
source:
This story pictures an innocent girl who a man (lead character) had been in love with since their childhood is humiliated by other men and ends up being married with someone else by force. But she soon began to enjoy sex....... 

[From [url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE021300.html]DLsite English[/url]]
translation:
本作描繪一名清純少女：主角從小便愛慕她，她卻遭其他男性羞辱，並被迫嫁給別人。但不久後，她開始享受性愛……

[摘自[url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE021300.html]DLsite英文版[/url]]
